We had our best Commercial Summit ever in Boston this week! The theme was Agentic Commercial, the new commercial model that will help the industry get the right medicines to more patients.  

Agentic Commercial changes the role of digital, websites, field execution, and content. We showed how we are enabling Agentic Commercial with Veeva Commercial Cloud. 

We also showed the significant breakthrough of 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗲𝗿𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗘𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲, using compliant free text to drive insights to increase commercial agility. We saw this through the Agentic Call Report in Vault CRM and through Ostro conversational AI for patients and HCPs.

Other Highlights...

  • Veeva AI. Everything, everywhere, all at once! In addition to Agentic CRM and Ostro, we talked about Agentic MLR in PromoMats, Vault AI here now, and Link AI coming soon. 

  • Vault CRM – More than 150 customers are now live with many more migrations from Veeva CRM on the way. Vault CRM is now far beyond what Veeva CRM ever was.  

  • Veeva Data Cloud – Veeva Data Cloud has strong momentum across OpenData, Link.  Compass Patient and Compass Prescriber are being used by many brands for better segmentation and targeting, especially for complex therapies. 

  • IQVIA Partnership – Great to have IQVIA as a partner and Summit sponsor! Customers really like our collaboration, especially the new IQVIA OneKey connector for Veeva Network. 

  • Ostro at Summit! Ostro joined Veeva two months ago, and I am so pleased with how Ostro is changing Veeva and the industry with new energy and ideas. Instant answers for patients and HCPs through conversational AI that's 100% compliant! 50 brands today, and 500 tomorrow!

Find out more and see the Ostro and Agentic Call Report demos in the 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗞𝗲𝘆𝗻𝗼𝘁𝗲 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵𝗹𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝘀 at https://lnkd.in/gAmkd3uu

repost.content:
I know Veeva Systems versus Salesforce for life sciences CRM is of interest to many and there’s a lot of misinformation and hype out there. So, I wanted to share my view and some key facts.

Why do I write a post like this? It’s an important decision that can have a big impact. I care about the industry, our customers, and our employees. Having focused on industry specific technology at Veeva for 18 years now, after many years in horizontal technology at IBM, PeopleSoft, and Salesforce, I have gotten to see a lot.   

Veeva is the best choice for life sciences CRM because it is a deep application that is proven today with live customers from a trusted company committed to the industry. It is also the fastest path to AI that is useful and practical for biopharma field teams.

Salesforce is too risky and too expensive. Salesforce does not have a deep application, live customers, or track record of commitment to the industry.
So, Salesforce customers will have to customize too much and recreate too many essential capabilities that already exist in Vault CRM. That leads to long, expensive, poor quality, and risky projects and a redo some years down the road when business models change.

Customers should be careful about the motives of system integrators and other third parties in this decision. A more expensive, more custom project means more revenue for system integrators and other third parties, so that must be considered and managed effectively in the decision process.

To help provide clarity, I’ve included some important information in the table below. It represents the facts as I know them and I will likely update the table every few months or so over the coming year.

For more detail on Veeva versus Salesforce, why the facts below are important, and how I think this will play out and why, see my blog post https://lnkd.in/gsrAU3iq
